description: This file initializes and configures internationalization (i18n) for a React frontend application. It sets up language resources, detects user language preferences, and manages text direction (RTL/LTR) based on language changes.

methods.name: i18n.use
methods.description: Registers plugins or modules for the i18n instance, such as language detector and React integration.

methods.name: i18n.init
methods.description: Initializes the i18n instance with configuration options, including resources and language detection settings.

methods.name: i18n.on
methods.description: Adds an event listener for language change events to update the document attribute for direction and language.
